stories.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
stories.simple_summary: A company called Oura is buying a health care startup called Counsel Health for 625 million dollars. This deal happened after Oura decided not to go public right now due to market conditions.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who use Oura's health ring. There is nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
stories.simple_summary: A company called PSI used AI to help solve a difficult question about quantum computers that scientists have been stuck on for almost 20 years. They used a powerful AI model from a company called Anthropic to do this.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to scientists and tech companies. For now, it does not affect ordinary people or small businesses.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out new business profiles, making ChatGPT just a little bit more like Google
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is adding new features to ChatGPT to help businesses show up when people search for things. ChatGPT is starting to work more like Google, letting businesses list themselves so people can find them.
stories.why_it_matters: Small business owners might eventually benefit if ChatGPT becomes a good way for customers to discover their business, similar to how Google search works today.

stories.title: The indie game community is in disarray over AI and Big Walk
stories.simple_summary: Independent game makers are arguing about using AI to help make video games. Some people who judge games say they will not vote for games that use AI at all, but one popular game called Big Walk says it used AI only a little bit at the end to help finish development.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to video game makers and the gaming community. Regular people who play games will not be directly affected.

stories.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic released a new tool called Claude Meetings that listens to your work conversations and automatically writes down plans, creates timelines, and answers questions during the meeting. It can also look up information from your other work apps.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business or work in an office, this tool could save time by turning your spoken discussion into written plans and action items automatically.

stories.title: Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI, is expanding its products beyond coding and enterprise tools. They are building more AI tools that work together like an office suite, similar to what Microsoft Office or Google Workspace does.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to businesses and tech investors right now. As these tools develop, small businesses might eventually use them to replace some of their current office software.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Nvidia had an affair with someone who is being investigated as a possible Chinese spy. This story is raising concerns about national security and the race between countries to build the best AI computers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a news story about a public figure. For most people and businesses, there is nothing you need to do about it.

stories.title: IBM and Microsoft Launch AI Agent Platform
stories.simple_summary: IBM and Microsoft announced that they are working together to launch a platform for AI agents. However, there is not enough detail in this headline to explain what this platform does.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to large corporations and technology investors. There is not enough information to say what it means for small businesses.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy could be a problem for the economy
stories.simple_summary: The Nvidia CEO's affair with an alleged Chinese spy is raising concerns about potential problems for the U.S. economy and national security. The article suggests this could have serious ramifications as countries compete in AI technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a geopolitical and economics news story. For ordinary people and small business owners, there is nothing specific you need to do right now.

stories.title: eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
stories.simple_summary: eBay has blocked AI agents from using its website to shop for items. This means tools like Meta's Muse cannot automatically browse eBay and create shopping lists for people anymore.
stories.why_it_matters: If you were using an AI agent to automatically shop on eBay, that tool no longer works there. For most small business owners and ordinary people, this does not affect you.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
stories.simple_summary: Google released a new AI model called Gemini 4 Carbon that is designed to be very powerful and can coordinate multiple AI agents working together like a group. Google says it is their strongest model yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important to tech companies and people building advanced AI systems. For small businesses and everyday people, there is nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips
stories.simple_summary: Google made two new computer chips designed to help run AI models better. One chip helps with private AI training and another gives AI systems more memory to work with.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and investors. There is nothing you need to do about it.
